hw-square.alt: A square divided by allele frequencies p = 0.7 and q = 0.3 along each side. The areas show genotype frequencies: AA is p² = 0.49, each Aa rectangle is pq = 0.21 for a total 2pq = 0.42, and aa is q² = 0.09. A note says to start from the aa corner: q² is the only genotype you can read from phenotypes.
